notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Fremont County Fair in Ashton, Rebecca, 208-360-8005, horsesnaussies@gmail.com, with a June 3 left message. Gmail confirms 2026 outreach to Rebecca.
